decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 22th April 2005 the erection of a single storey rear extension measuring 6.05m wide by 3.65m deep by 3.1m height with a flat roof and the erection of a detached outbuilding at the end of the rear garden to measure 6m length by 6.6m width by 4m height with a ridged roof was lawful within the meaning of Section 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

Condition : 2 - Informative: The detached out building hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 95 Heath Road and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or separate habitable unit).
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension and detached single storey building comprising garage/store to rear of house.
